title: Distinguish an earlier retired write from the current evaluator's terminal unavailable result
outcome: A reused evaluator's terminal unavailable summary describes its own refusal or lack of a verdict, while preserving a separate notice that an earlier locally retired write has an unknown outcome.
acceptance: When only a previous attempt has a locally retired write, a current attempt ending without a recorded verdict or with a confirmed refusal reports that current status and separately retains the earlier unknown-outcome notice.
Current Pending, Unconfirmed and locally retired writes retain their own uncertainty wording, and behavioral tests cover both current and previous-attempt cases.
